notes: Court themes: every court now comes in eight looks: Pro Arena, Neon Night, Rooftop Sunset, Junkyard, Frozen Rink, Woodland Road, Outer Space and Hell. The host picks one in the lobby, or Random for a different look every match. Themes only change the scenery, never how a court plays.
